items.name: qatt-font
items.title: Qatt Font
items.description: IBM Plex Sans Arabic as --font-sans: body and UI text (Arabic + Latin). SIL OFL 1.1.

items.name: qatt-font-heading
items.title: Qatt Heading Font
items.description: Readex Pro as --font-heading: display and headings (Arabic + Latin). SIL OFL 1.1.

items.name: qatt-font-mono
items.title: Qatt Mono Font
items.description: IBM Plex Mono as --font-mono: code (always LTR). SIL OFL 1.1.

items.name: qatt-theme
items.title: Qatt Theme
items.description: Al-Qatt Al-Asiri palette: gypsum-wall light mode, night-majlis dark mode, pigment and motif-slot tokens, gypsum surface scope, and the three Qatt fonts.

items.name: qatt-utils
items.title: Qatt Utils
items.description: Shared helpers for Qatt UI items, including the typed motif registry.

items.name: use-direction
items.title: useDirection
items.description: Reads the text direction (rtl/ltr) from the nearest DirectionProvider.

items.name: qatt-divider
items.title: Qatt Divider
items.description: A horizontal zigzag band (hanash motif) that separates sections, drawn with currentColor.

items.name: button
items.title: Button (Qatt)
items.description: Button with the base-nova API plus qatt, qatt-outline and painted (tone) variants.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge (Qatt)
items.description: Badge with qatt (yellow paint) and pigment (tone) variants.

items.name: card
items.title: Card (Qatt)
items.description: Card with a painted variant (2px ink border, flat painted shadow).

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs (Qatt)
items.description: Tabs with a qatt list variant (painted diamond under the active tab).

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog (Qatt)
items.description: Flat dialog, logical close button, qatt bordered variant.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet (Qatt)
items.description: Sheet with logical sides (start/end) resolved from the text direction.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion (Qatt)
items.description: Accordion with start-aligned triggers and a qatt variant.

items.name: input
items.title: Input (Qatt)
items.description: Input with 3:1 boundary, solid focus outline and a qatt ruled-line variant.

items.name: select
items.title: Select (Qatt)
items.description: Select with logical padding, check at inline-start and a qatt trigger variant.

items.name: sonner
items.title: Toaster (sonner) (Qatt)
items.description: Toaster that follows the text direction (dir + default position).

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip (Qatt)
items.description: Ink tooltip with logical inline-start/inline-end placement.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb (Qatt)
items.description: Breadcrumb with an RTL-flipping chevron and chevron/slash/khatmah separators.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination (Qatt)
items.description: Pagination with Arabic defaults, RTL-aware chevrons and a qatt active page.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar (Qatt)
items.description: Avatar with a pigment ring and toned fallbacks; RTL-safe group overlap.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator (Qatt)
items.description: Separator with a qatt variant (three thin parallel rules).
